lines.zh: 咔哒咔哒，机关声响动不息。
机械齿轮转动，发出轻微响声。
lines.en: Mechanical gears turn, making a soft noise.

lines.zh: 走动时金属摩擦声不断。
lines.en: Metallic rubbing sounds accompany its walk.

lines.zh: 机关人偶在找下一个目标。
lines.en: The puppet is looking for its next target.

lines.zh: 这里是缘壹零式的领地。
木壳下的齿轮咬得很准。
lines.en: The gears beneath my wooden shell mesh precisely.
I wander in straight lines, never curving.

lines.zh: 机械关节放松，暂时停顿。
无尽循环的机关停转片刻。

lines.en: I must be ready at all times.
Mechanical eyes gaze into the distance.

lines.zh: 木头的身体，关节一格一格转。
lines.en: A wooden body, joints turning notch by notch.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，等你的破绽。
lines.en: I stand perfectly still, waiting for an opening.

lines.zh: 玩家进入我的攻击范围。

lines.en: My wooden arms are wound and ready to swing.

lines.zh: 我抬起木制的脸，对着你不动。
lines.en: I raise my wooden face and hold it toward you.
Tracking player, waiting for the right moment.

lines.zh: 玩家是我的下一个目标。
木屑从我肩缝里崩出来。
lines.en: Wood splinters burst from the seam in my shoulder.

lines.zh: 机关木偶的关节卡住了。
饥渴难耐，机关人偶开始游荡。
lines.en: Hunger drives the automaton to wander.
Scouring for food in every corner.

lines.zh: 食物诱人，但我不能停下。
lines.en: Food is tempting, but I must keep moving.
Tempted by the taste, I strike.

lines.zh: 食物近在咫尺，却难以触及。
lines.en: Food is within reach, but elusive.
Too small, not worth the effort.

lines.zh: 找到食物，机械生命得以延续。
lines.en: Food found, my mechanical life continues.

lines.zh: 金属撞击声，机关人偶突然出现。
碰撞引发连锁反应，机关人偶加速。
lines.en: Collision triggers a chain reaction, speeding up.

lines.zh: 机关人偶身体碰撞，产生火花。
lines.en: Sparks fly as the automaton collides.

lines.zh: 机关人偶互相碰撞，彼此攻击。
金属碰撞，发出沉闷声响。
机关人偶被推倒，自行复原。
撞击导致机关人偶受损，发出哀鸣。
机关人偶相撞，各自继续游荡。
机关人偶之间频繁碰撞，维护自我。
寻找同伴，发出机械叫声。
lines.en: Calling for a mate, emitting a mechanical sound.

lines.zh: 机械声中寻找交配对象。
lines.en: Seeking a mate through mechanical sounds.

lines.zh: 发出交配信号，吸引同类型。
lines.en: Sending mating signals to attract companions.

lines.zh: 机械声中，寻找合适的伴侣。
lines.en: Mechanical sounds guide the search for a mate.

lines.zh: 机械声吸引同类，准备交配。

lines.en: Mate approaching, mechanical sounds grow louder.

lines.zh: 机械声中，确定交配对象。

lines.en: Mechanical sounds of joy as companions meet.

lines.zh: 同类之间，只用木响应答。
lines.en: Between kin, only wooden knocking answers.

lines.zh: 机甲外壳发出轻响，关节转动着。
动力系统启动，嗡嗡声响起。
机械臂缓缓张开，寻找食物。
lines.en: Mechanical arm opens slowly, searching for food.

lines.zh: 检测到食物信号，开始移动。
机械腿踏步前进，寻找猎物。
lines.en: Mech legs step forward, seeking prey.

lines.zh: 启动武器系统，准备攻击。
lines.en: Weapon systems activated, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 确认食物位置，瞄准射击。
lines.en: Targeting food source, preparing to fire.

lines.zh: 发出低沉的嗡嗡声，威慑敌人。
木臂里的机关，转起来了。
lines.en: The mechanism in my wooden arm begins to turn.

lines.zh: 木偶的关节，自己转了过来。
lines.en: The puppet's joints turn by themselves.

lines.zh: 机关转动，我的刀举起来了。
lines.en: The gears turn and my blade comes up.

lines.zh: 六只木臂一齐抬起来了。
lines.en: All six wooden arms have lifted.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸节奏我记下了。
lines.en: I have recorded the rhythm of your breathing.

lines.zh: 缘壹零式不做无用的动作。
lines.en: Yoriichi Type Zero wastes no motion.

lines.zh: 木刀先出一寸，你看不清。
lines.en: The wooden blade leads by an inch you cannot see.
There is an opening in your stance.

lines.zh: 我又多了一个练习对象。
lines.en: I have one more practice partner.
Aiming at target, lock and shoot.

lines.zh: 我是木头的，可我的刀法不是。
lines.en: I am made of wood, but my swordsmanship is not.

lines.zh: 机关齿轮咔哒一声，我算好距离。
lines.en: A gear clicks; I have judged the distance.
Aiming at prey, ready to capture.

lines.zh: 我每一只手臂都对准一个方向。
lines.en: Each of my arms points a different way.

lines.zh: 六只手臂各持一刀，缓缓张开。
lines.en: Six arms spread wide, each holding a blade.

lines.zh: 我抬起弩臂，弦已经拉满。
lines.en: I raise my crossbow arm, the string already drawn.

lines.zh: 人偶的眼睛亮起，盯住你的咽喉。
lines.en: The puppet's eyes light up and fix on your throat.
First cut, down upon the shoulder.

lines.zh: 六臂轮转，你挡不住全部。
lines.en: Six arms rotate. You cannot block them all.

lines.zh: 我算好了你退后的步数。
lines.en: I have calculated how many steps you retreat.
My wooden blade parts the air almost silently.
Knockback will not help. I keep chasing.
This form has been practiced a thousand times.

lines.zh: 你抬手的那刻已经晚了。
lines.en: The moment you raised your arm, it was late.

lines.zh: 我不会给你第二次呼吸。
lines.en: I will not grant you a second breath.

lines.zh: 木关节锁死在攻击角度。
lines.en: My joints lock at the striking angle.
Did you hear the gears stop?

lines.zh: 木偶的手臂抬起，刀锋对准你。
lines.en: The puppet's arm rises, its blade aimed at you.
Six arms fall as one. Nowhere to dodge!
The wooden joint numbs your arm!
That one landed square on your ribs!
My blade is not fast, but it is heavy!
Your blade cannot hold against mine, can it?
My shell is splitting, yet I do not stop!
This puppet was trained, not built!
One step back from you, one step forward from me!
Forget the pain. Can you not?
Wood splinters. The form is not finished!

lines.zh: 木偶从林间走出，关节吱呀作响。
lines.en: The puppet walks out of the trees, joints creaking.
My wooden joints click as they turn.
A wooden frame rises from the soil.

lines.zh: 六臂慢慢张开，认准方向。
lines.en: Six arms spread slowly, choosing a direction.
My wooden shell is burning. Put it out!
Even a wooden dummy can be blown apart.

lines.zh: 箭钉进我的胸口，木屑乱飞。
lines.en: An arrow lodges in my chest; splinters fly.

lines.zh: 木偶坠下去，齿轮还在空转。
lines.en: The puppet falls, its gears still spinning in nothing.
